payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes last digits of multiples of d (1d..9d); if a query number >= 10*d, always YES; else check if last digit matches a multiple not exceeding the number.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a number-theoretic threshold rule and digit matching, not dynamic programming, complete search, or greedy. Among provided subtypes, none correctly describes the method; dp_2d_state is the top-scored candidate but is a mismatch.
